lens: Prospective client — service failure (simulated AI acceptance lens)
reason: The offer is understandable: student-led, pro-bono research and recommendations over a semester, with 6–8 members and a responsive client contact. I traced home → client services → contact through actual source and the supplied intercepted journey test. Inquiry prompts support a useful first conversation; provider failures have an email fallback. Desktop/mobile homepage captures show coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy and explicit pending-approval disclosure. However, partnership names do not let a client judge delivered work, and the inquiry confirmation has an unchecked success boundary. These limitations and absent hosted delivery evidence prevent an unqualified world-class or release endorsement. This is independent AI source/capture review, not observed client success or a review of every private workflow.

findings.evidence: JSON parse failure becomes null; only response.ok is checked before form.reset() and the sent message. A 2xx response containing null, invalid JSON, or {ok:false} therefore produces the same confirmation as the API contract {ok:true} in src/app/api/contact/route.ts:52. The inspected browser journey supplies only the valid success fixture.
findings.userImpact: An anomalous service response can erase a detailed inquiry and tell the client it was sent without a valid acknowledgement. This is a source-derived failure path, not an observed hosted incident.
findings.suggestedFix: Require a validated {ok:true} receipt before resetting fields; preserve the inquiry and explain uncertain delivery with the board email alternative on malformed receipts. Add a focused browser check for this failure.

findings.evidence: Every selected organization states that scope, methods, deliverables and outcomes await approval. src/content/projects.public.ts:5 contains an empty release list; work/page.tsx:56–63 omits Selected work when empty. The homepage capture likewise discloses pending case studies.
findings.userImpact: A prospective client can understand the process but cannot assess the quality or relevance of a completed engagement from the supplied revision. Organization descriptions establish client context rather than MECG delivery evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain client/board approval for at least one concrete question, method and redacted deliverable or handoff example before treating the portfolio as sufficient world-class proof. Preserve the honest pending state until approval; fabricate no outcomes.

notVerified: Actual hosted inquiry delivery, configured recipient, spam handling and board response within the stated week; email API acceptance does not establish inbox receipt.
Real client comprehension, inquiry completion or recovery success; supplied journey tests intercept contact HTTP and are not a human study.
Client approval and factual substantiation of partnership/stat claims; confidential data handling, retention and NDA execution in practice.
Contact/work visual rendering beyond source; supplied public captures inspected here depict the homepage. Physical devices, Safari, Firefox and assistive technology remain unverified.
No staging or hosted acceptance environment exists; private authenticated integrations and operator workflows are outside this seat’s sampled journey.
